commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) is caught offside yet again.
90+4' 1 - 1 Martin Baturina (Como) finds some space on the edge of the penalty box and smashes the ball into the top right corner! What a beauty!
90+4' Nico Paz (Como) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+3' Nico Paz (Como) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post.
90+2' Jean Butez (Como) sends a long ball forward to Nico Paz, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
90+1' Stefan Posch (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
89' 14:3 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
88' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
88' Ciro Immobile (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
86' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) finds a little space near the penalty spot and heads the corner from Maxence Caqueret goalwards, but the attempt goes miles wide of the right post.
86' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nico Paz (Como), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Como earn a corner.

86' Martin Vitik (Bologna) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. Martin Vitik (Bologna) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
84' It is time for a substitution. Martin Baturina (Como) is on for Alberto Moreno.
84' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Tommaso Pobega will be replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Bologna).
83' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
83' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
81' Alberto Moreno (Como) sends a cross into the box, but Federico Ravaglia comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
79' Nico Paz (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
76' Jonathan Rowe will be replaced by Nicolo Casale (Bologna).
76' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) replacing Remo Freuler.
76' Santiago Castro goes off the pitch and Ciro Immobile (Bologna) comes on.
75' Stefan Posch (Como) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
74' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Federico Ravaglia comes off the line to clear the ball away.
73' Maxence Caqueret (Como) tries to find Anastasios Douvikas with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
71' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nico Paz (Como), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
70' The referee is firm and issues Nadir Zortea (Bologna) a deserved yellow card.
70' Juan Miranda (Bologna) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
69' 7:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. 2:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
68' A precise low pass is received by Maxence Caqueret (Como), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
68' Maxence Caqueret (Como) takes the corner but it's cleared.
68' Nico Paz (Como) latches on to a lofted pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a sweet strike. Unfortunately for him, the ball only rattles the right post. What a goal that would have been!
67' The Como players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Rosario Abisso. NO PENALTY!
65' Celebrations by Como are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
65' Remo Freuler (Bologna) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

64' Martin Vitik (Bologna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Como!
63' It will be a substitution. Stefan Posch (Como) is ready to enter the pitch as Ignace Van der Brempt walks off.
62' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna). He’s got to go!

58' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna), but referee Rosario Abisso must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
58' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) displayed very unsporting behaviour. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
58' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
57' Here is a change. Lucas Da Cunha is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Maxence Caqueret (Como).
57' Mergim Vojvoda comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como).
56' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
53' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) tries to find Nicolo Cambiaghi, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
51' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to release Jesus Rodriguez with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
49' 0 - 1 GOAL! Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Da Cunha (Como) was quite harsh and Rosario Abisso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' A brilliant individual effort! Jesus Rodriguez (Como) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
47' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

45+3' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Mergim Vojvoda was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Como.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Tommaso Pobega collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
42' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Como will take a throw-in.
41' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
40' Nico Paz (Como) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
36' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
34' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
33' Jesus Rodriguez finds Lucas Da Cunha (Como) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
32' The corner by Juan Miranda (Bologna) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.

32' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:4. Shots on target – 2:1.
29' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) attempts to find Santiago Castro, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is being substituted because of an injury. Vincenzo Italiano sends Martin Vitik on the pitch.
26' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
24' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

24' Nico Paz (Como) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

23' Nico Paz (Como) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Federico Ravaglia!
22' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) unleashes a powerful first-time volley towards goal, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
21' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) commits a rough foul. Rosario Abisso stops the game and makes a call.
18' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
18' Juan Miranda (Bologna) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

18' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
16' The possession of the ball – 53:47.
16' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) offside.
15' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Rosario Abisso who sees an offensive foul.
12' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
12' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) sends a long ball forward to Alberto Moreno, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
11' Referee Rosario Abisso sees the trip by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
10' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
10' The Como players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

7' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Federico Ravaglia allowed him to make a comfortable save.
7' Nico Paz (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
4' The ball is cleared after Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Como force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Flag goes up against Mergim Vojvoda (Como) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

1' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Jean Butez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
